description: This file defines the Currency model class for the admin localisation module in OpenCart. It contains methods for managing currency records, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving currency data from the database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class for currency management within the localisation module, providing CRUD operations and retrieval functions for currency data.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Creates a new currency record in the database using provided data.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record identified by currency ID with new data.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the value of a currency identified by its code.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Deletes a currency record from the database using the currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record by its currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves multiple currency records based on filter criteria, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total count of currency records in the database.
